tool.name: BWA indexer
tool.command: mkdir '$index.extra_files_path' && cd '$index.extra_files_path' && bwa index #if str($index_a) != 'auto' -a '${index_a}' #end if -p 'reference' '${reference}'

param.name: reference
param.label: Select a genome to index
param.help: Build an index for this FASTA sequence.

param.name: index_a
param.label: Algorithm for constructing the BWT index
param.option: Auto. Let BWA decide the best algorithm to use
IS linear-time algorithm for constructing suffix array. It requires 5.37N memory where N is the size of the database. IS is moderately fast, but does not work with database larger than 2GB
BWT-SW algorithm. This method works also with big genomes
